.gitignore Generator

Tick your stack (Node, Python, Java…) and get a combined, ready-to-commit .gitignore file.

📖 How to use

  1. Tick the stacks and tools your project uses.
  2. Click Generate — the merged .gitignore appears below.
  3. Copy it or download as .gitignore.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which stacks are covered?

Node, Python, Java, Go, Rust, PHP, Ruby, .NET, macOS, Windows, Linux, VS Code, and IntelliJ — mix and match.

Can I combine multiple stacks?

Yes — templates are merged with a section header per stack and duplicates removed.

Are these the official templates?

The templates follow widely used community conventions for each ecosystem.

How do I use the file?

Click Download .gitignore and place the file at your repository root.
